chunks.title: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana) - Objectives & Coverage
chunks.content: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) is the flagship crop insurance scheme of the Government of India designed to provide financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage arising from unforeseen natural events.
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, PMFBY Operational Guidelines

chunks.title: PMFBY - Coverage of Risks: Heavy Rain, Flood, and Inundation
chunks.content: PMFBY covers localized calamities including heavy unseasonal rain, inundation/waterlogging, hailstorms, landslides, cloudbursts, and natural fire. When standing crops are submerged or damaged due to heavy rain or flooding, farmers are eligible for localized assessment.
chunks.source: PMFBY Localized Calamity and Post-Harvest Loss Provisions

chunks.title: PMFBY - Mandatory 72-Hour Claim Notification Rule
chunks.content: For localized calamities such as heavy rain, inundation, hailstorm, or cyclone, the farmer MUST report the crop loss within 72 hours (3 days) of the occurrence through the Crop Insurance App, toll-free helpline 14447, or nearest Bank/PACS.
